register.labelZh: INVITE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 當你想邀請某人與你的團體一起參加音樂會、旅程、散步或其他活動時,可以使用 invitesomebody along。；invite somebody round、over 或 around 可以用來邀請朋友、鄰居或親友到家中作客。；invite somebody back 可以描述在電影、晚餐、派對或其他活動結束後,邀請某人到另一個地方繼續相聚。；invite somebody in 或 up 表示歡迎某人進入家中;invite somebody out 則表示邀請某人到餐廳或其他地方參加社交活動。
register.summaryEn: Invite somebody along is useful when you want another person to join your group for a concert, trip, walk or other activity. Invite somebody round, over or around lets you ask friends, neighbours or relatives to visit your home. Invite somebody back helps you describe an invitation made after a film, meal, party or other event. Invite somebody in or up welcomes a person inside, while invite somebody out describes an invitation to a restaurant or another social place.

Notice the difference between joining an activity and going somewhere socially: invite somebody along = ask somebody to join you or your group invite somebody out = ask somebody to go somewhere socially, such as a restaurant These expressions describe different kinds of invitations involving a home or another private place: invite somebody round/around/over = ask somebody to visit your home invite somebody in/up = ask somebody to enter or come upstairs invite somebody back = after an activity, ask somebody to continue spending time with you somewhere else
